# gezor_role (Resource)

A custom role in a workspace. Use `gezor_permissions` to list permission keys. People are assigned to roles in the portal.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gezor_permissions" "all" {}

resource "gezor_role" "data_engineer" {
  key         = "data_engineer"
  name        = "Data engineer"
  description = "Runs pipelines and manages topics"
  permissions = [
    "clusters.read",
    "clusters.manage",
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) Unique key, for example `data_engineer`. Cannot be changed.
- `name` (String)
- `permissions` (Set of String) Permission keys. `portal.access` is always granted and can be left out.

### Optional

- `description` (String)
- `workspace` (String) Workspace id or slug. Defaults to the provider's `workspace`. Changing it recreates the resource.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Role id.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Append @<workspace> to import from a workspace other than the provider default.
terraform import gezor_role.example <role_id>
```
